1. Digital-First Design

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No nuclear safety decision automated without ONR-approved safety case and human sign-off
  • ❌ No classified programme data processed outside UK-sovereign infrastructure
  • ❌ No export-controlled component procurement without DES&D export licence verification
  • ❌ No trilateral information sharing without treaty-compliant information barrier
  • ❌ No nuclear propulsion system modification without independent nuclear safety review
  • ❌ No workforce safety training reduced or automated without MoD Chief Nuclear Officer approval
